publications.name: The Long War – Codex Supplement Imperial Fists

infoLinks.name: And they shall know no Fear

rules.name: Hammer Strike
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, it and any attached unit are treated as having rolled a Minor Deviation when arriving via Deep Strike. In addition, Lysander and any attached unit may re-roll charge the rolls the turn they arrive from Deep Strike or Disembark from a Transport

rules.name: Pain is a Lesson
rules.description:
• All Imperial Fists army must re-roll successful Feel No Pain rolls made using the Feel no Pain Special rule.
• If your opponent is Iron Warriors, you must play 1 additional Battle Round of the battle regardless of the battlepack rules.

rules.name: Chapter Drills
rules.description:
All Imperial Fists units in your army gain the following benefits:
• Imperial Fists units re-roll all to hit rolls of 1 with Bolt Pistol, Boltguns, Heavy Boltguns, Heavy Bolters, Linked Boltguns, Linked Heavy Bolters, Gatebreaker Boltguns and Chainswords.
• Imperial Fists units gain the Siege Attacker special rule.

sharedRules.name: Only in Death
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Last Stand special rule.

rules.name: Terror Scouts
rules.description:
A unit with this upgrade gains the Fear (1) and Crusader special rule. In addition, they gain Shock Grenades.
• A Terror Scout unit may exchange their Astartes Shotguns for Ferromag Shotguns for 1pt per model.

rules.name: Boarding Shield
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains a 5+ Invulnerable save. If at least 3 models in a unit are equipped with Boarding Shields, all charges against the equipped unit are treated as Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Wardens Cuirass
rules.description: A model with this wargear may re-roll 1 failed Armour save roll per Phase.

rules.name: Auric Aquilla
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains a 6+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Indomitable
rules.description: A Warlord with this trait and any attached unit gains the Crusader special rule. In addition, any combat they are involved in which would be lost is considered a tied combat instead.

rules.name: Stubborn Heroism
rules.description: The Warlord and any attached unit gain the Stubborn and Counter-Attack special rules.

rules.name: Superior Architect
rules.description: All Fortification type units in your army gain a 5+ Invulnerable Save. In addition, you may include 1 additional Fortification slot in your army per 500pts.

modifiers.value: {unit} must have terminator armour equipped to take {this}

rules.name: Armour of Tyr
rules.description: A model with this Wargear has a 2+ Armour Save, 4+ Invulnerable save and the Relentless & Slow & Purposeful special rules. In addition, the equipped model gains +1 to their Toughness (T) characteristic.

rules.name: The Eye Hypnoth
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic and any attached unit gains the Sunder special rule on all equipped weapons.

rules.name: The Bones of Osrak
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic may re-roll Psychic Tests.

rules.name: Duty’s End
rules.description: A model with this Wargear gains a 3+ Invulnerable save and the Battle Hardened special rule. The equipped model gains +1 to their Wounds (W) characteristic.

rules.name: Icon of the Iron Cage
rules.description: A model with this Wargear and any attached unit gain the Stubborn special rule. In addition, the equipped model and any attached unit gain Hatred (Iron Warriors).

rules.name: Indomitan Mantle
rules.description: A model with this Wargear gains +1 to their Armour Save (max 2+). In addition, improve the equipped models Invulnerable Save by +1 (to a max of 3+).
